concepts.name: Patterns in Mathematics
concepts.definition: Central learning focus of Patterns in Mathematics.
concepts.source_evidence: Mathematics is, in large part, the search for patterns, and for the explanations as to why those patterns exist.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Support a conclusion with source information or valid working.
concepts.source_evidence: Such patterns indeed exist all around us — in nature, in our homes and schools, and in the motion of the sun, moon, and stars.

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Transfer the learned idea to a relevant new context.
concepts.source_evidence: They occur in everything that we do and see, from shopping and cooking, to throwing a ball and playing games, to understanding weather patterns and using technology.
